findings.message: Selecting a sort option removes the focused button without restoring focus. DOM simulation confirmed focus falls to BODY.
findings.remediation: Restore focus to the sort trigger after selection or keyboard dismissal; consider the established local Select primitive.

findings.message: Closing the category picker removes its focused search field without restoring focus. DOM simulation confirmed Escape leaves focus on BODY.
findings.remediation: Restore trigger focus after keyboard dismissal and selection while preserving outside-click focus behavior.

findings.message: The category combobox announces a listbox popup, but its controlled element uses role="radiogroup" at line 508.
findings.remediation: Use a consistent accessible popup pattern with matching roles and keyboard behavior.

findings.message: Mobile footer links animate indefinitely inside a clipped strip without a pause control or pause on keyboard focus. Only reduced-motion preferences stop the animation.
findings.remediation: Review a static scrollable presentation or provide a pause mechanism and stable keyboard targets.
